name: form-field-context
title: Form Field Context
description: Shared React context for FormField state (hasError, disabled, id, name). Used by input components to auto-read form field state.

docs.lead: Shared React context that propagates FormField state (hasError, disabled, id, name) to child input components. Automatically installed with FormField and consumed by all input components.

api.name: useFormField
api.description: Hook to access FormField context values. Returns default values when used outside a FormField.

api.name: FormFieldContext
api.description: The React context object. Use FormFieldContext.Provider to wrap custom form field implementations.

props.name: hasError
props.description: Whether the field has a validation error.

props.name: id
props.description: The field ID, used for label/input association.

props.name: name
props.description: The field name, used for react-hook-form integration.
